title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Retired Reserve Closing Reconciliation and Activation-on-Orders Credits Already Posted
content:
Under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, for a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan: Activation-on-orders credits already standing against a bill taken in are taken off what that bill brings into the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation: where they cover only part of the days that bill covers, they are spread over the days they cover and taken off for the counted days from the first day they cover; where they cover every day that bill covers, they are spread over those days and taken off for every counted day; otherwise nothing is taken off.

**Terms.** The credits are those with reason activation on orders already standing against the bill, in total, over the coverage days they show; credits covering part of a bill's days cover its last days, through the month's end. Spreading divides them by those days; the daily figure is taken off once for each counted day reached.

**Hypothetical.** The June monthly bill of 614.07 covers 30 days; activation-on-orders credits of 409.38 stand against it covering 20 days, 11 to 30 June; counted days are 15 to 30 June. Taken off: 409.38 divided by 20, 20.469 a day, for 16 days, 327.504.
